title: Divergence: forge engine::nonstandard_axiom binds to the FIRST #print axioms line, not the obligation theorem's — earlier clean #print masks a smuggled axiom (#248 allowlist bypass)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at /home/doll/Thermite/forge/tests/divergence_axiom_marker_mask.rs::divergence_replay_masks_nonstandard_axiom_via_earlier_print demonstrates the divergence. engine::nonstandard_axiom uses print_axioms_output.find("depends on axioms:") (FIRST occurrence) + .lines().next(); replay appends '#print axioms thermite_obligation_<item>' LAST. A proof file emitting its own earlier '#print axioms clean_helper' (propext-only) makes the first marker clean → smuggled 'thermite_cheat : ∀ (p:Prop), p' masked → f certifies L3 with trust_profile omitting the axiom. Live (lake+verus present): cert observed level=L3. Fix must bind the parse to the obligation theorem's report line (e.g. anchor on "'thermite_obligation_<item>' depends on axioms:" or parse the LAST/all markers).
